views.rationale: AMZN's cost of sales increased 20% in the third quarter of 2018, compared to 30% in the same period in 2017, indicating a slowing rate of growth.

BA's cost of sales as a percentage of revenues decreased by 0.3% in the nine months ended September 30, 2018, compared to the same period in 2017, indicating a slight improvement in operating efficiency.
BAC's net income increased $218 million in the third quarter of 2018, driven by lower noninterest expense and a decrease in income tax expense from the reduction in the federal income tax rate.

GOOGL's other income (expense), net, increased $1,576 million from the three months ended September 30, 2017 to the three months ended September 30, 2018, while GS's net revenues in credit products were lower, primarily reflecting lower client activity.
GOOGL's other income (expense), net, increased 5.3% of revenues, while JNJ's operating expenses (excluding cost of revenues) were $11.1 billion, and income from operations was $8.3 billion.
KO's net operating revenues increased 4% due to volume, while LIN's net loss was $9,397,039.
JPM's net income increased 24%, reflecting higher net revenue, while KO's net operating revenues increased 4% due to volume.

NVDA's gross margin increased to 60.4% for the third quarter of fiscal year 2019 from 59.5% for the third quarter of fiscal year 2018, while MSFT's gross margin was 19.2% for the three months ended September 30, 2018.
